questions.prompt: An administrator must protect rg-app against accidental ARM deletion while permitting authorized ARM configuration updates. Sibling resource groups must receive no additional lock restriction. No locks currently apply. Which complete lock configuration meets the requirements?

options.explanation: It blocks deletion in rg-app while permitting authorized updates. Sibling groups are outside its scope.
It blocks both updates and deletions in rg-app. Blocking updates violates the requirement.
It also restricts sibling groups; the requested boundary is rg-app.
It also restricts sibling groups; it additionally blocks the required updates.

questions.prompt: A storage account has a CanNotDelete management lock. A client is authorized for both a control-plane account deletion and a data-plane blob deletion through the Blob service endpoint. Networking permits access and no other protection or restriction applies. Which pair of outcomes follows while the lock remains?

options.text: The account operation is blocked; the blob operation is permitted.
options.explanation: The management lock restricts the control-plane operation, while the authorized Blob-service data operation is outside its scope.

options.text: The account operation and blob operation are both blocked.
options.explanation: The management lock does not restrict the data-plane blob operation.

options.text: The account operation and blob operation are both permitted.
options.explanation: The account control-plane operation is blocked by the effective management lock.

options.text: The account operation is permitted; the blob operation is blocked.
options.explanation: This reverses the operation-plane boundary of the management lock.

questions.prompt: An Owner attempts an ARM deletion of vm-app and receives a lock error. The only applicable lock is a user-created CanNotDelete lock directly on vm-app. The administrator is authorized to remove that lock and has approved deliberate deletion. Which sequence resolves the failure?

options.text: Remove the CanNotDelete lock, then delete vm-app.
options.explanation: Owner can remove this user-created lock, but deletion is blocked until the lock is removed.

options.text: Keep the lock, then retry deletion using the Owner identity.
options.explanation: The lock restricts authorized users; repeating an Owner request does not bypass it.

options.text: Keep the lock, assign Contributor, then retry deletion.
options.explanation: Changing the resource-management role does not remove the lock restriction.

options.text: Replace CanNotDelete with ReadOnly, then delete vm-app.
options.explanation: ReadOnly also blocks deletion; replacing the lock does not permit the requested operation.
